features: BLAZING FAST TRANSFERS - Experience rapid file transfers with speeds up to 1050MB/s read and 1000MB/s write, thanks to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface, saving you valuable time when moving large files.
EXPANDED STORAGE CAPACITY - Available in 1TB and 2TB capacities, the Lexar SL300 provides ample space for your photos, videos, documents, and more, ensuring you have the storage you need on the go.
ULTIMATE DURABILITY - With IP54 dust and water resistance and 2m anti-drop protection, this rugged SSD is built to withstand the rigors of daily use, keeping your data safe in various environments.
COMPACT AND PORTABLE DESIGN - Measuring just 3.96 x 1.97 x 0.41 inches and weighing only 1.48 oz, the Lexar SL300 easily fits in your pocket or bag, making it the perfect travel companion.
WIDE DEVICE COMPATIBILITY - Seamlessly works with PC, Mac, tablets, iPads, Android devices, and iPhone 15 & 16 series, offering versatile connectivity for all your devices via USB Type-C.
